display.purpose: Warm editorial hierarchy for page-level headlines only.

body.purpose: Planning, settings, forms, and status copy.

shadows.name: button-primary
shadows.purpose: Hard, unblurred edge revealed by the short mechanical lift.

shadows.name: surface-soft-sm
shadows.purpose: Restrained separation for elevated surfaces; fields use a separate quiet inset treatment.

motion.name: control-response
motion.purpose: A short mechanical lift for primary actions plus crisp border, fill, text, and focus response.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The original mechanical primary action with a short hard-shadow lift and compact press response, paired with crisp focus and no glossy sweep or glow.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 700 14px/1.25 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-button-primary); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(.95); box-shadow: none; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 3px var(--primary); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A transparent structural action using the existing two-pixel edge.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 700 14px/1.25 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--button-shadow-base); } .ds-button-outline:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 3px var(--ink); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The existing compact field with semantic fill, a transparent resting edge, and quiet inset depth.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control-border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--input); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--field-shadow); font: 500 14px/1.25 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { box-shadow: var(--field-shadow-hover); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background), 0 0 0 3px var(--foreground); } .ds-input:disabled { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 70%, transparent); color: var(--slate-muted); box-shadow: none; opacity: .7; }

components.name: Product Surface
components.description: A restrained semantic surface that does not alter route structure.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: var(--elevation-soft-sm); font: 400 15px/1.5 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

narrative.overview: Preserve TeamForge's existing UI anatomy and apply a restrained semantic theme. Balanced dark is truly black; alternate palettes remain purpose-led.
keyCharacteristics: True-black default dark environment and neutral light environment.
Restrained 12px control geometry and approximately 20px major surfaces.
Mechanical actions use a short hard-shadow lift while fields stay unelevated with quiet inset shading.
Established route-specific SVGs and semantic icon tiles remain in use until replacement is explicitly requested.

rules.name: Preserve Anatomy
rules.body: Theme work changes semantic styling, not page structure or component identity.

rules.name: Semantic Meaning
rules.body: Palette atmosphere may change, but interaction and feedback roles keep their meaning.

rules.name: Interaction Cue Priority
rules.body: Prefer mechanical lift, edge, ink, or icon response before using a background tint; reserve fill changes for ghost controls and persistent selected states.

rules.name: Focus Color Scope
rules.body: Neutral controls use a foreground focus edge; teal focus belongs only to controls whose surface and content are already teal.

rules.name: Neutral Heading Context
rules.body: Do not decorate headings with teal eyebrows, kickers, route names, or subtitles. Remove redundant labels and render useful dates, progress, and section metadata as neutral supporting text.

rules.name: Visual Asset Authorization
rules.body: Treat supplied imagery as visual reference only; preserve existing product assets unless replacement is explicitly requested.

dos: Do preserve existing routes, controls, and Appearance information architecture.
Do keep the Balanced dark application background exactly black.
Do test keyboard focus, contrast, zoom, and preference startup behavior.
donts: Don't replace established controls with generic floating pills or glass cards.
Don't increase radii as a shortcut for polish.
Don't infer permission to integrate new assets from a stylistic reference.
